therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Disruption of microtubule formation in abnormal keratinocytes
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adult participants with actinic keratosis on face or balding scalp
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Local tolerability assessed by erythema, flaking/scaling, crusting, swelling, vesiculation/pustulation, and erosion/ulceration scores

results.effect_size: Peak local tolerability composite score 4.1 at Day 8, returning to baseline levels by Day 57
safety_signals: Local skin reactions (erythema, flaking/scaling, crusting, swelling)
2/105 participants with adverse events of special interest (skin cancers)
results.dose_information: Applied topically for 5 days over approximately 100 cm² treatment area
